title: Wayfare Pass Student Verification Schedule
content:
# Wayfare Pass student verification schedule

Student verification matters only on the Student plan of Wayfare Pass (rider membership). The schedule below gives, for every plan, how long a student verification stays valid, the grace after it lapses and the plan a lapsed student membership converts to.

| Plan | Verification valid for (calendar months from the verification date) | Re-verification grace after lapse (calendar days) | Plan a lapsed student membership converts to at its next renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 12 | 14 | Wayfare Pass Monthly |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 0 | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 0 | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 0 | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 0 | 0 | none |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 0 | 0 | none |

## Reading the schedule

- **Verification valid for**: student verification is valid for this many calendar months from the verification date; 0 for the non-student plans.
- **Re-verification grace**: the number of days after student verification lapses before the plan converts at the next renewal, in calendar days; 0 for the non-student plans.
- **Conversion plan**: the plan a lapsed student membership converts to at its next renewal; none for the non-student plans.

## Points of reading

- *Which plans carry a verification period?* Only Wayfare Pass Student; every other plan shows 0 months and no conversion plan.
- *Hypothetical example:* a Student member verified on 1 September holds a verification valid for 12 calendar months from that date, and the re-verification grace after it lapses is 14 calendar days.
